articles.headline: Valdez homers and the Pirates use 8 pitchers in a 4-2 win over the White Sox
articles.description: — Rookie Esmerlyn Valdez hit a solo shot, rookie Konnor Griffin singled in two runs in Pittsburgh’s three-run seventh inning and the Pirates held on to beat the Chicago White Sox 4-2 on Wednesday night for their third straight victory.

articles.headline: Arizona Diamondbacks vs. Kansas City Royals: Game Highlights

articles.headline: Witt homers to help the Royals beat the Diamondbacks 5-2
articles.description: — Bobby Witt Jr. hit a three-run home run in the fifth inning and the Kansas City Royals beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-2 on Wednesday night in a game that was delayed 50 minutes by rain at the outset.
articles.headlineJa: ウィットの本塁打でロイヤルズがダイヤモンドバックスに5-2で勝利
articles.descriptionJa: ボビー・ウィット・ジュニアが5回に3ラン本塁打を放ち、カンザスシティ・ロイヤルズは水曜日の夜、雨のため開始が50分遅れた試合でアリゾナ・ダイヤモンドバックスを5-2で破った。

articles.headline: Lindor and Morel power the Mets to a 15-14 win over the Marlins
articles.description: — Francisco Lindor hit a three-run homer, Christopher Morel added a two-run shot and finished a triple shy of the cycle as the New York Mets outslugged the Miami Marlins 15-14 Wednesday night to complete a series sweep.

articles.headline: Henderson, Yelich lead Brewers past Cubs for series sweep
articles.description: — Christian Yelich hit a three-run homer, Logan Henderson threw five innings of two-hit ball and the Milwaukee Brewers completed a sweep of rival Chicago, holding on for an 8-6 victory Wednesday night to extend their NL Central lead to 10 games over...

articles.description: Kylian Mbappé up front and Thibaut Courtois in goal; does Jose Mourinho really need any more than that? ESPN's Mark Ogden, Gab Marcotti, Rob Dawson and Sam Tighe weigh in on all the moments that mattered from Matchday 1 so far.

articles.headline: Mac Allister stunner gives Liverpool win amid contract sadness

articles.headline: EuroLeague sets Oct. 5 to vote on role in NBA Europe project
articles.description: EuroLeague owners are set to meet on Oct. 5 in Milan, Italy to discuss whether to accept the NBA proposal and allow the league to be absorbed into NBA Europe or continue to operate as a separate league.
